title: How Code Comprehension works
subtitle: Follow one assessment through the system.

chapters.title: Three parts, one learning loop
chapters.subtitle: The agent understands. The runtime coordinates. The browser teaches.
lines: Your coding agent reads the repository.
The local runtime checks and serves quiz data.
The browser turns that data into a learning session.

chapters.title: Evidence comes first
chapters.subtitle: Code → questions, explanations, references
lines: PR quiz: reason about what changed.
Product quiz: reason about current behaviour.
Changed source fingerprints trigger a bank review.

chapters.title: The contract is a boundary
chapters.subtitle: Valid structure is necessary. It is not proof of truth.
lines: A shared schema rejects malformed quiz data.
The agent repairs the reported problems.
Valid structure does not guarantee factual accuracy.

chapters.title: Two kinds of assessment
chapters.subtitle: MCQs score locally. Written answers need a reviewer.
lines: MCQs use the supplied answer key in the browser.
Written answers go to a waiting coding agent.
The agent returns feedback grounded in code evidence.

chapters.title: Feedback belongs to an attempt
chapters.subtitle: A retake must never inherit an old review.
lines: Each sitting has its own attempt identity.
A retake creates a new attempt.
Feedback from the old attempt cannot overwrite it.

chapters.title: The architecture to remember
chapters.subtitle: Generate with evidence → validate → learn → review
